bandProfile.name: Sioto Jazz
bandProfile.summary: Sioto Jazz is an alternative rock band from Bitola, Macedonia, formed in 2022. The band blends raw emotion with introspective melodies, small-town summers, fleeting connections, and the pull between roots and wanderlust.
bandProfile.liveNote: Rotating players expand the live setup for bass, drums, and sound.
